description: Generates an ELSTER UStVA XML snapshot for archiving. Does NOT submit (submission goes via elster_ustva_start). Useful for audit trails.

report.description: Map of Kennziffer → amount in EUR. Keys are the bare 2-3 digit code (e.g. "81", "66"). Net amounts for NET-type codes, tax amounts for TAX-type codes.
